THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

Your final question

As you record, the four years fill in, in page order. Which way do the years go, and why does the book end there?

THE SCENE

You ask the questions on the school talk show. Today the show is about one book. Your final question needs four years from the book. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This show is about a book by Julia Alvarez. Her family moved from the Dominican Republic to New York in 1960. The four sisters in her book make the same move.
